purpose: Check whether a small fixed seek-lead reduction can select a later non-forward keyframe

incomplete_capture.note: No first fragment was emitted within the 1.8 second capture window.

absolute_latency_exclusion_reason: The NAS 128 KiB random Range responses varied around 0.27 to 0.59 seconds per probe and dominated the run.
result: At these targets, reducing the fixed lead by 0.1 seconds selected the same keyframes and provided no mechanism-based speedup.
design_implication: A no-forward optimization must identify RAP times and choose the latest RAP at or before the original target. Passing a fixed negatively biased target through the current seek path does not guarantee that result.
